text:
anya: quick UX sync on routing editor  updated prototype includes a collapsible help bar, denser rule chips, and a preview overlay when validation errors exist. need contrast/a11y + copy suggestions. figma: https://figma.mock/route-editor

rob: looks solid. two quick things: 1) help bar is 70px and hides top rule on keyboard nav; can collapse to ~34px when focus enters rules list? 2) chip contrast feels low at 14px.

kevin: ran automated contrast: chip bg #EEF3F8 + text #111827 = 3.8:1 at 14px. fails WCAG. option: darken text to #0B1220 (4.6:1) or tweak bg. prefer darkening to keep tokens.

maya: copy nit for disabled preview banner: current "Fix rules to preview" -> use "Resolve rule issues to enable preview"  clearer and reads better with screen readers. also add aria-live polite for validation updates and set aria-hidden on preview when overlay active.

anya: decision: darken chip text to #0B1220 at 14px, make help bar auto-collapse on scroll or keyboard focus, disable preview toggle when invalid and show inline banner with maya's copy, add aria-live + aria-hidden. rob/maya please open a PR with CSS tokens, i18n key preview.disabled.resolve_rules, and visual regression screenshots for normal/overlay states.

ci-bot: queued visual-regression for branch maya/rules-help-collapse; will report back when complete.
